desc:
🏄 SURF FOR EGGS! 🥚

🌊 Surf across the ocean, steal rare Eggs, and make it back to your Pen!

💡 How to Play:

* 🏄 Surf to different islands and discover new Egg zones!
* 🥚 Steal an Egg and bring it back to your Pen!
* 🐊 Watch out for the Animals chasing you!
* 🌊 Avoid HUGE waves while carrying your Egg!
* 💥 Get hit by a wave OR an Animal and you'll DROP your Egg!
* 🏃 Escape and get your Egg safely back home!
* 🐣 Hatch your Eggs to discover rare Pets!
* 💰 Earn Cash from your Pets!
* ⚡ Use the Surfing Treadmill to become FASTER!
* 🏝️ Travel farther to discover better and rarer Eggs!

🌊 The farther you surf, the better the Eggs you can find!

🥚 Can you steal the rarest Eggs and make it home?

👍 Like the game and join the group for FREE rewards!

🎮 Supports PC, Console, Mobile, and Tablet!
